hook: Binding a small ligand can push rubisco into new multi-part assemblies, without evolving new protein contacts.
summary: By sampling more members of one rubisco clade, the authors found a range of oligomeric responses to ligand binding and pinpointed structural features behind the shifts. This suggests ligand binding can open a route to new quaternary structures. The evidence covers one rubisco clade, so how general the route is remains open.
title: Structural basis of ligand-mediated transition to higher-order rubisco assemblies
